name: Motorized Bicycle
description: Missouri's moped: a two- or three-wheeled device with an automatic transmission whose motor produces less than 3 gross brake horsepower (2,250 W) and can't propel it faster than 30 mph on level ground. It needs a licensed rider but no title or registration. Defined by Revised Statutes of Missouri §301.010 and regulated by §307.195; electric bicycles are excluded.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels and an automatic transmission; pedals aren't required
Its motor produces less than 3 gross brake horsepower (2,250 W) and can't propel it faster than 30 mph on level ground
The definition also caps the motor's cylinder capacity at 50 cc, a gas-engine measure, and excludes electric bicycles by name rather than electric motors
Riders need a valid driver's license; no motorcycle endorsement
Not titled or registered with the Department of Revenue
